seal.statement: The durable split or merge workflow record is the authorization owner for source-mirror START, and PartitionService owns exactly one physical worker for that authorization. The source installs an authorizing handle, records SNAPSHOT_STARTED against the current record, and begins snapshot work only after that record change accepts the exact workflow attempt, fence, and immutable execution payload. Concurrent exact STARTs join the same authorization and worker. A lost START answer after durable acceptance is confirmed from the record and continues the same logical attempt and fence instead of writing DEFERRED and re-registering; a truly unaccepted delivery may defer. Stale or different-payload STARTs cannot install work or borrow a prior acknowledgement. A newer attempt is admissible only after explicit predecessor quiescence, and recovery of an accepted START resumes the same attempt without fabricating predecessor progress.
